stories.title: Expanded NCD survey in Andhra Pradesh to cover four additional health conditions
stories.summary: The Department of Health, Medical and Family Welfare has announced that health screenings being conducted in the State under the Non-Communicable Diseases (NCD) survey will be expanded to cover four additional health conditions — obesity, fatty liver disease, chronic respiratory conditions and mental health disorders. Until now, screening has been conducted for people aged 18 and above for five major health conditions — hypertension, diabetes, oral cancer, breast cancer and cervical cancer.

stories.title: Bhiwandi Food Poisoning: 17 Fall Ill After Allegedly Eating Chicken Shawarma, BNCMC Demolishes Unauthorised Food Stall
stories.summary: Bhiwandi: In yet another suspected food poisoning incident raising serious concerns over food safety in the city, 17 people, including young children and women, were hospitalised after allegedly consuming chicken shawarma from AK Shawarma, a food stall near Vanjarpatti Naka in Bhiwandi.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai Crime: NMMC Suspends Doctor After 42-Year-Old Woman Alleges Sexual Harassment At Turbhe Civic Hospital
stories.summary: The APMC police have registered a case of molestation against the doctor, identified as Dr Saurabh Borse, following the woman's complaint. The civic administration has also initiated a departmental inquiry into the matter, with further action to be decided based on its findings.

stories.title: From slurred speech to an uneven smile: Doctor shares mini-stroke warning signs and when to call an ambulance
stories.summary: Slurred speech that clears up in minutes may still signal a mini-stroke. When someone briefly slurs their words and then starts speaking normally again, it is easy to chalk it up to tiredness , especially if they say they feel fine. But such a sudden change in speech can be a sign of stroke.

stories.title: Chef Sanjeev Kapoor shares a simple recipe for crispy paneer pakoda with a spicy twist
stories.summary: Chef Sanjeev Kapoor shares an easy-to-make recipe that elevates the classic paneer pakora with a spicy green chutney layer in the middle. Warm and crispy paneer pakodas hardly need any improvement as a rustic, comforting snack on any occasion. However, celebrity chef Sanjeev Kapoor introduces a spicy green chutney within it as he shares the recipe for preparing the snack on his blog.

stories.title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds
stories.summary: The largest health board in Wales is still failing, with "fundamental weaknesses" in its governance and management, according to a new report. Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (BCUHB) has been in special measures for around half its existence, with the latest period starting in 2023.

stories.title: Karnataka HC declines to quash case against government doctor for attesting documents of 14 illegal Bangladeshi immigrants to secure Aadhaar card
stories.summary: The High Court of Karnataka refused to quash a criminal proceedings against a government doctor for allegedly attesting the forged documents related to residential addresses of several illegal Bangladeshi immigrants enabling them to secure Aadhaar card in Bengaluru. P. Sandesh passed the order while rejecting a petition filed by Lokesh, a government doctor who is a gazetted officer authorised to attest documents.

stories.title: Fertility after 30: Doctor debunks common myths and explains how age affects reproductive health
stories.summary: Worried about fertility after 30? Here's what doctors want women to know about age and pregnancy. Turning 30 often brings several questions about fertility, especially for women who are planning to start a family. There is a common belief that a woman's ability to conceive drops sharply after 30.

stories.title: Is your family history hiding a deadly secret? A medical oncologist reveals the genetic risks of pancreatic cancer
stories.summary: While several lifestyle and environmental factors contribute to pancreatic cancer development, family history and inherited genetic mutations can also play an important role in determining an individual's risk of developing it. Approximately 5–10% of pancreatic cancer cases are believed to have a hereditary component.

stories.title: Frankfurt Airport workers die after malaria infection
stories.summary: Citing Frankfurt health officials, Germany's DPA news agency reported that the first death occurred in July and that the cause of death was not immediately clear at the time. The second fatality was in August. The cases are part of a rare outbreak of so-called airport malaria , with six employees infected despite not having traveled to a malaria-risk country.

stories.title: India's health bill: Who really pays?
stories.summary: In October 2026, a 27-year-old woman from Mathura who had lost the ability to walk underwent two complex spinal operations in Lucknow. At a private hospital, doctors estimated, the treatment could have cost Rs 6–7 lakh. That same month, in Odisha's Bargarh district, a daily-wage worker was borrowing money to buy medicines for his family.

stories.title: De-notification of MSMER-2023 removes overlapping procedures, but will it safeguard standards of medical education?
stories.summary: The National Medical Commission (NMC) has de-notified and withdrawn the Maintenance of Standards of Medical Education Regulations, 2023 (MSMER-2023) where medical colleges were liable to face penalty fines for violations of educational standards and infrastructure requirements at medical colleges. Earlier reports in The Hindu stated NMC’s withdrawal of MSMER-2023 weakens accountability in medical education by removing provisions to fine individual faculty members and administrators up to ₹5 lakh for submitting false information.

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Priyansh Arya breaks record, marks highest individual T20 score by an Indian
stories.summary: Delhi skipper Priyansh Arya rated his scintillating 68-ball 181 (7x4, 19x6) against Tamil Nadu in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) as the best innings of his career. Arya rewrote the record books, registering the highest individual T20 score by an Indian and equalling the record for the most sixes in a T20 innings, alongside Finn Allen.

stories.title: Sooryavanshi smashes fastest List A double hundred
stories.summary: India’s teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi etched his name in the history books on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), shattering the world record for the fastest double hundred in List A cricket with a 52-ball blitz against the UAE in the Rising Stars Asia Cup. Sooryavanshi surpassed the record held by Chad Bowes, who scored a 200 off 103 balls for Canterbury against Otago in the Ford Trophy in 2024.

stories.title: Russia accuses NATO member Estonia of hostile actions ‘on the verge of unleashing open war’
stories.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry has lashed out at Estonia's government, accusing the NATO member of carrying out a range of "hostile actions" and putting the Baltic state "on the verge of unleashing open war" with Moscow. The outburst underscores rising tensions between Russia and countries on NATO's eastern flank and comes after Estonia announced it will close its road border crossings with Russia from Dec.

stories.title: ICC has no plans to review saliva ban despite calls from Shubman Gill
stories.summary: The International Cricket Council doesn't plan to review its ban on applying saliva to the ball due to health and cricketing reasons despite calls from Indian captain Shubman Gill .

stories.title: Sooryavanshi, 15, breaks sixes record by scoring 204 off 53 balls
stories.summary: India's 15-year-old batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit the most sixes ever recorded in a senior men's innings in blazing 204 from 53 balls for India A against the United Arab Emirates. While almost halving the record for the fastest double-century in List A cricket, Sooryavanshi hit 28 sixes and seven fours in the Asia Cup Rising Stars competition - easily breaking Chad Bowes' previous record of 103 balls from 2024 .

stories.title: FSSAI sanctions prosecution against Bisleri over unsafe packaged drinking water
stories.summary: Based on the laboratory findings, FSSAI concluded that the company had violated provisions relating to unsafe food under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

stories.title: Priyansh Arya rewrites SMAT record books with 181, hits 19 sixes

stories.title: Pro Wrestling League Season 6 To Be Held From 3rd–19th January 2027 In New Delhi; Player Auction Scheduled For 30th November In Mumbai
stories.summary: New Delhi, November 24, 2026: The Pro Wrestling League (PWL), on Saturday, announced the revised schedule for Season 6, which will now be held from 3rd January to 19th January 2027 under the aegis of the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI).

stories.title: PT Usha out of IOA president's race, Gagan Narang, Virendra Sachdeva in fray
stories.summary: A relatively new-look Indian Olympic Association (IOA) is on the cards. On Tuesday, the final day of nominations, Olympic shooting medallist Gagan Narang and Archery Association of India secretary general Virendra Sachdeva filed their nominations for the post of IOA president. Former IOA secretary general Rajeev Mehta is also in the fray for the top post, making it a three-way contest.

stories.summary: The Indian series was up against the UK's A Thousand Blows , France's Careme and Argentina's Menem . It was Careme , an Apple TV production, that took home the award, leaving India without a win this year. While the result didn't go India's way, the nomination meant a lot to the team behind Real Kashmir Football Club .

stories.title: ‘Butcher’s job in surgeon’s gown’: Delhi's Priyansh Arya hits T20 record-breaking 181
stories.summary: There is a certain contradiction to Priyansh Arya's batting. The destruction is often brutal, the sixes come thick and fast and bowlers can be left looking hapless. Yet, there is little about his demeanour that suggests a batter in hurry. He is calm, you have to really goad him for answers and he gives very little away about his game or personality.

stories.title: USA joint bid and UK confirmed as 2031 and 2035 FIFA Women's World Cup hosts
stories.summary: FIFA on Monday (November 23, 2026) confirmed that a joint bid led by the United States will host the expanded, 48-team Women's World Cup in 2031, while the United Kingdom will host the following edition in 2035.

stories.title: Gloucestershire renamed Bristol Lions for T20 Blast
stories.summary: Gloucestershire will rebrand as Bristol Lions for the T20 Blast from the 2027 season. The club revealed their intentions earlier this month to change their identity for the format to include Bristol, the city where they play home matches at the Seat Unique Stadium, as part of a strategy to "reach a new audience".

stories.title: Is Hamilton and Leclerc's Ferrari partnership sustainable? F1 Q&A
stories.summary: Max Verstappen triumphed in a thrilling Las Vegas Grand Prix ahead of the McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri. There were 34 lead changes across the 50 laps of racing as Dutchman Verstappen held off attacks from Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and George Russell, plus his Red Bull team-mate Isack Hadjar.

stories.title: Chess: I want to be a World champion like Gukesh, says Amudhan
stories.summary: Tamizh Amudhan grabbed the headlines when he defeated the then World No. 7 Vincent Keymer. When D. Gukesh takes on Javokhir Sindarov, a nine-year-old wunderkind in Sivakasi is likely to have his attention far from his homework throughout the World chess championship. stories.title: PBKS appoint Paras Mhambrey as bowling coach
stories.summary: Punjab Kings Set To Appoint Paras Mhambrey And Rajiv Kumar As Bowling And Fielding Coaches Ahead Of IPL 2027 Season | Mohali: Punjab Kings (PBKS) are set to appoint Paras Mhambrey and ex-Chennai Super Kings (CSK) staff member Rajiv Kumar as their bowling coach and fielding coach, respectively, ahead of the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL) season, reported Cricinfo.

stories.title: IND vs NZ first Test Day 5: New Zealand batters blunt Indian attack; match ends in draw
stories.summary: The wind picked up but the pitch remained lifeless. And with the New Zealand batters preferring to dead-bat all through the day, India’s bowlers fell short from putting New Zealand under pressure and instead had to settle for a draw at . With New Zealand starting the last day’s proceedings at 119 for two, India had eight overs to pick in a bid to register a rare Test win in New Zealand.

stories.title: 204 runs, 28 sixes, 384.91 strike rate: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking madness
stories.summary: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi produced carnage against UAE on Tuesday, rewriting the record books with a sensational 204-run knock in the Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 in Doha. The 15-year-old brought his A-game to the fore as the UAE bowlers bore the brunt of his assault.

stories.title: No Emmy For India! Manav Kaul, Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyubs Real Kashmir Football Club Loses To France In Drama
stories.summary: India failed to secure a win at the 54th International Emmy Awards 2026, held on November 23 in New York City (November 24 in India). The ceremony, hosted by Michael Urie, saw India's sports drama Real Kashmir Football Club lose in the Drama category to France's historical drama series Careme.

stories.title: D Gukesh on World Chess Championship: I’m not here to defend, I’m here to win
stories.summary: Defending champion Gukesh is clear how he doesn’t want to look at the World Chess Championship that begins on Tuesday. “I’m not here to defend anything…I’m here to win it all over again.” Gukesh said at the opening press conference in Geneva on Sunday. “Sindarov has just been very consistent and in very good form.

stories.title: Priyansh Arya smashes highest T20 score ever by Indian in epic SMAT blitz
stories.summary: Delhi skipper Priyansh Arya rewrote the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy record books with a breathtaking 68-ball 181 (7x4, 19x6) against Tamil Nadu in a Group-B clash at the Daly College ground here on Tuesday, registering the highest individual score and hitting the most sixes in an innings in the tournament’s history.

stories.title: 'Breaking the door down': Ex-cricketer hails Priyansh Arya after record-breaking 181
stories.summary: Arya smashed a sensational 181 off just 68 balls against Tamil Nadu on Tuesday, becoming the highest-scoring Indian batter in T20 cricket history. The 25-year-old surpassed KL Rahul's previous Indian record of 152 not out off 67 balls, scored for Delhi Capitals against Punjab Kings at the Arun Jaitley Stadium earlier this year.

stories.title: Fisher replaces injured Tickner in New Zealand's Test squad
stories.summary: Pacer Blair Tickner has been ruled out of the second Test against India with a right hamstring injury. He suffered the setback during training in Wellington and will now receive further assessments in Christchurch. Once the final outcome is determined, his expected return-to-play timeline will be set.

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Hebbar guides Andhra to a thrilling win; Kerala coasts to a facile victory
stories.summary: Ashwin Hebbar’s rearguard, unbeaten 63 (37b, 5x4, 2x6) anchored Andhra to a tense three-wicket win over Pondicherry, and strengthened its qualification chances from Pool C, in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy cricket tournament on Tuesday. Chasing 148, Andhra was pushed to the wall after slumping to 77 for five, but found its crisis man in Hebbar, who had thrived as a finisher in this tournament.

stories.title: Indian sports wrap, November 24: Indian U19 Boys win Bronze at World Youth Table Tennis Championships in Istanbul
stories.summary: The Indian boys’ U-19 team bagged a bronze medal in the ITTF World Youth Table Tennis Championships in Istanbul on Tuesday. India blanked Turkey 3-0 in the quarterfinals to assure itself of a medal and then lost to Chinese Taipei 3-0 in the semifinals.

stories.title: 'Special Talent': BCCI VP Rajeev Shukla Praises Vaibhav Sooryavanshi After Record Double Century; VIDEO
stories.summary: BCCI Vice-President Rajeev Shukla praised young Indian batsman Vaibhav Sooryavanshi after his record-breaking double century against the United Arab Emirates (UAE) in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 on Tuesday. Sooryavanshi shattered several records with 204 runs off just 53 balls, including a century in 28 balls and a double century in 52 deliveries.

stories.title: De Villiers claims Australia's 2018 ball tampering 'started in Durban'
stories.summary: Former South Africa captain AB de Villiers , who played a series-defining role in 2018 against Australia, weighed in on the Sandpapergate, alleging that the ball tampering ploy might have been used in the first Test in Durban as well. Cameron Bancroft, Steve Smith and David Warner were handed bans for the use of sandpaper in the Cape Town Test.

stories.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi Creates List A History! 15-Year-Old Star Batter Smashes 28 Sixes In An Innings To Break All-Time Record
stories.summary: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has taken List A cricket by storm with a breathtaking display of power-hitting, creating history during the Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026. The teenage sensation smashed more than 28 sixes in a single innings, surpassing the previous all-time record of 23 sixes held by Australia's D'Arcy Short.

stories.title: 'Not everyone did it': Hughes hits back at Lehmann's 150-year ball-tampering claim
stories.summary: Merv Hughes has expressed disagreement with Darren Lehmann's statements regarding the long history of ball-tampering in cricket. He emphasised that the practice was not prevalent during his playing days or as a selector. Hughes noted that former players trying to justify past actions are problematic in their claims.

stories.title: What does ₹1.25L monthly budget look like? ‘ ₹30,000 grocery, ₹20,000 grooming’: Noida couple’s expenses go viral
stories.summary: Owning a home does not always mean that monthly expenses are low. 25 lakh every month, even though they own their house and do not have to pay rent. Wedding bells may soon ring for pop star Miley Cyrus and her fianc Maxx Morando.

stories.title: Does Scotland's NHS have a revolving door problem with senior managers?
stories.summary: Scotland health and social care correspondent Published 2 minutes ago A recurring theme in the debate over the problems at NHS Grampian has been concern at a revolving door of senior managers in Scotland's NHS. stories.title: The price of no climate deal: After COP31, what's next for India and the world | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations (UN) climate summit in Antalya, COP31, ran two days over schedule and ended on November 22 without a cover decision, the overarching text that sums up what a summit achieved. As petrostates like Saudi Arabia and Russia pushed to omit fossil fuels from the final draft, the text was reluctantly accepted by many countries.

stories.title: Explainer-Mexico nabs yet another top drug lord, but history of ‘Kingpin Strategy’ mixed
stories.summary: Chapo Isidro was considered one of the leaders of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, a former ally of the powerful Sinaloa Cartel that later became one of its top rivals. His capture is the latest in a string of arrests of high-profile suspected drug traffickers as Mexico — under intense pressure from US President Donald Trump — has decisively returned to the so-called Kingpin Strategy.

stories.title: Who Is Madhimalar? Muttiah Muralitharan's Wife Turns Heads At Anirudh-Kavya's Wedding Reception
stories.summary: Former Sri Lankan cricket legend Muttiah Muralitharan's wife Madhimalar Ramamurthy attended the wedding reception of music composer Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran in Chennai. Her pictures from the event are going viral on social media and it highlights her fitness transformation and elegant appearance.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission: Civilian defence staff seek 6% annual increment, OPS and 50% DA merger— 13 key demands explained
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Pratiraksha Mazdoor Sangh (BPMS), an all-India federation of civilian defence employees recognised by the Ministry of Defence, has submitted a fresh list of around 73 demands to the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC), seeking substantial improvements in salaries, pensions and service benefits for central government employees, particularly defence civilian personnel.

stories.title: How AI is changing Indian courts and why human oversight still matters in passing judgements
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has released its first draft Regulations for Use of Artificial Intelligence in Courts, 2026, as AI is increasingly used to translate judgments, record witness statements and do legal research. stories.summary: By Archit GuptaEvery person’s personal finance rests on three things. The first is protecting yourself and your family through life and health insurance. The third is building wealth, turning your savings into a corpus that grows over time, whether that corpus is a retirement fund decades away or simply money set aside for a year-end holiday.

stories.title: Cases against Megaspeed, the Singapore firm tied to Jensen Huang’s brief ouster from Nvidia | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The US on Monday blacklisted Megaspeed International, the Singapore company whose former chief executive's affair with Jensen Huang led to his brief ouster from Nvidia , as an investigation continues into whether it moved the American firm's AI chips into China. Nvidia reinstated Huang the same day the US announced its decision.

stories.title: Who is Sugandha Hiremath? Meet businesswoman at centre of Kalyani family’s ₹1 lakh crore ancestral wealth dispute
stories.summary: Sugandha Hiremath, sister of Bharat Forge chairman Baba Kalyani, is at the centre of a high-profile inheritance dispute involving the Kalyani family’s ancestral wealth , estimated at more than ₹ 1 lakh crore. stories.title: How many calories does an Indian body burn? This room may tell us
stories.summary: How many calories does your body burn while you sleep? Does an Indian diet trigger a different metabolic response from a Western diet? stories.title: ‘IDBI Bank’ not ‘State’ under Article 12, rules Supreme Court; dismisses appeal by association | What we know
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that IDBI Bank does not qualify as a "State" under Article 12 of the Indian Constitution. The decision means the bank does not fall within the definition of "State" for constitutional remedies under the provision. The ruling comes as a setback for the bank's officers' association, even as the Central government has maintained that the interests of employees and pensioners have been fully protected.

stories.title: Taxpayer sold Bitcoin worth ₹4.94 crore and disclosed it in ITR, yet faced a tax notice. Why? HC ruling explained
stories.summary: A taxpayer who disclosed Bitcoin transactions worth nearly ₹ 5 crore in his income tax return still faced reassessment proceedings after the Income Tax Department alleged that he had failed to report the cryptocurrency transactions. The dispute eventually reached the Gujarat High Court, which found that the department's allegation was based on an incorrect reading of the taxpayer's return.

stories.title: Why BJP is keen on renaming West Bengal ‘Paschim Banga’? | Explained
stories.summary: On November 23, 2026, West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that the State will be referred to as ‘Paschim Banga’ in all languages including English. Mr. Adhikari said the State Cabinet had passed the proposal and a new resolution to the effect would be tabled in the Assembly on December 9.

stories.title: Who is Harpreet Singh Bhatia? Former India U-19 cricketer who hit a 120-ball 100 for UAE against India A
stories.summary: Harpreet Singh Bhatia, once regarded as one of India’s promising young batting talents, found himself up against his former cricketing countrymen on Tuesday, scoring a 100 off 120 balls, with 11 fours and a six, for the UAE against India A in a must-win Group B encounter at the Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 in Doha.

stories.title: ‘Portfolio rebalancing’: JioStar to lay off around 150 employees this week - what we know

stories.title: Mint explainer: Why India's TReDS platforms have set sights on global markets
stories.summary: Indian invoice-discounting platform M1xchange, which helps small businesses get paid early against unpaid invoices, is in talks with foreign banks in Russia and Brazil to set up local trade receivables discounting systems (TReDS), Mint reported on 23 November. stories.title: India's first AI-enabled drug-testing van deployed at Worli Racecourse concert in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Anti-Narcotics Cell has introduced AI-enabled forensic vans to enhance drug detection at music events.
